question: What deficiency invalidates an offering made to the deity?
premises: An offering to the deity is considered.
The living principle may be absent from that offering.
The verse frames this absence as a condition.
inference: An offering made to the deity without the living principle is deficient.
uncertainties: The precise referent of jīvatattva is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: O goddess, if one offers to the deity without the living principle.
